subtopics.title: End Systems and Their Role
subtopics.summary: What hosts (end systems) are, where they sit at the network edge, and their role in running network applications before connecting to the network core.

subtopics.title: Home Access: DSL, Cable, and FTTH
subtopics.summary: Wired residential access technologies: DSL over telephone lines, cable over HFC (shared vs. dedicated bandwidth), and fiber to the home, including typical data rates.

subtopics.title: Ethernet and WiFi Access
subtopics.summary: Local access via Ethernet LANs in homes and enterprises, and IEEE 802.11 wireless LANs in homes, offices, and public hotspots.

subtopics.title: Cellular and Wide-Area Wireless Access
subtopics.summary: Mobile access through cellular networks (3G, LTE/4G, 5G), enabling untethered Internet access for hand-held devices over wide areas.

subtopics.title: Guided Physical Media
subtopics.summary: Characteristics and uses of guided media: twisted pair (UTP/STP), coaxial cable, and optical fiber, including where each is deployed.

subtopics.title: Unguided Physical Media
subtopics.summary: Wireless propagation of signals in radio channels: terrestrial microwave, WiFi/cellular radio bands, and satellite links, and how the environment affects them.
